The '''Diamalan Commerce Ministry''' was a branch of the [[Diamal]]an government. During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]] they purchased twelve [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]] to use as transport escorts.
